note: Log and failure-message signatures. Each is a case-insensitive regular expression with the classification it indicates and what it names. environment: the runner, network, registry, disk, memory or a service the job needs. data: test data or fixtures wrong for this run. A signature is evidence, not a verdict: classify.py combines it with the step kind, the re-run outcome and the history.

(ETIMEDOUT|ECONNRESET|ECONNREFUSED|Connection refused|Connection reset by peer|Failed to establish a new connection|Read timed out|NewConnectionError)

date_marker: Dates (YYYY-MM-DD) in a failure message or a fixture it reads that fall before the run date are a data marker.
